Message.Name: Trade, Trade Amendment or Cancellation 1 Leg Buy Private Information Message
Message.Description: Sent by the server to inform about a trade produced due to any reason other than order matching, also to inform about trades produced due to order matching in a Dark pool. The user is involved in the trade as Seller

Field.Name: TransactionDateAndTime
Field.Description: Transaction Date and Time in nanoseconds since 1-jan- 1970 UTC

Field.Name: BuyerBolsaCode
Field.Description: Stock Exchange code of the buyer

Field.Name: LastChangeFlag
Field.Description: Indicates if this trade changes the instrument Last price

Field.Name: BENC_RFPT_Flag
Field.Description: Benchmark or Reference Price Indicator MMT

Field.Name: PublishDateAndTime
Field.Description: Publication Date and Time in nanoseconds since 1-jan- 1970 UTC

Field.Name: SICAVFundCounterpartySide
Field.Description: Indicates the side of the Counterparty member in a SICAV or Mutual Fund

Field.Name: AmendedTradeType
Field.Description: Trade type of the amended/cancelled trade

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: System Trade Number of the amended/cancelled trade

Field.Name: EntryDate
Field.Description: System order entry date (when System Order Number was assigned)

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Application Order ID (unique at security level)

Field.Name: ClientDataID
Field.Description: Client Data ID (to be used as a shortcode in orders and quotes)

Field.Name: CSDBIC
Field.Description: BIC of the Central Securities Depositary
